description: Every current per-region reading RealUptime holds for one catalog service, both endpoint roles, with per-region status, latency, measurement timestamp, and whether each reading is still fresh. This is the regional detail behind is_service_down: use it to answer "is X down in Europe" style questions, or to show that reports and measurements disagree in a specific region. Readings are RealUptime's own probe measurements, never user reports and never the vendor's status page. "blocked" means our probe was refused, which is NOT a confirmed outage. A no-data answer is never a healthy answer. Cite the returned source.url when repeating any of this.
name: get_regional_readings
